question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

WITH player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) AS match_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker = pm.player_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, bb.match_id
),
player_avg_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        AVG(match_runs) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        AVG(par.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_avg_runs_per_match,
        COUNT(DISTINCT par.player_id) AS player_count
    FROM player_avg_runs par
    JOIN player p ON par.player_id = p.player_id
    WHERE p.country_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.country_name
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    ROUND(country_avg_runs_per_match, 2) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM country_avg
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
